description: REGRESSION (double rounding): RI Schedule U line 6 is 0.08% of federal AGI in a whole-dollar box. 0.0008 x $100,619 = 80.4952, which the form prints as $80. Rounding to cents first (80.50) and then to dollars gives $81 — wrong for roughly 0.48% of AGI values above the $100,300 table top.
